ramayana-6-44-14.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-15.translation: Knowing himself without a weapon, full of anger, the bull among monkeys quickly tore up a mountain.
ramayana-6-44-15.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-16.translation: Holding that great rock in one hand, mighty Hanuman gave a great roar and whirled it.
ramayana-6-44-16.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-17.translation: Then he rushed at Akampana, lord of demons, as Indra rushed at Namuchi in battle with the thunderbolt.
ramayana-6-44-17.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-18.translation: Seeing the raised mountain peak, Akampana shattered it from afar with great crescent arrows.
ramayana-6-44-18.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all. Battle scenes are told plainly in the epic; the app keeps them brief.

ramayana-6-44-19.translation: Seeing the mountain top split by the demon's arrows in the sky and fallen scattered, Hanuman grew wild with anger.
ramayana-6-44-19.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-20.translation: Full of rage and pride, the monkey went to an ashvakarna tree and quickly tore it up, tall as a great mountain.
ramayana-6-44-20.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-21.translation: Holding that great-trunked ashvakarna, the splendid one, laughing with great joy, whirled it in battle.
ramayana-6-44-21.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-22.translation: Running with great speed, breaking trees by force, very angry Hanuman split the earth with his feet.
ramayana-6-44-22.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-23.translation: Wise Hanuman struck down elephants with their riders, chariots with their warriors, and demons on foot.
ramayana-6-44-23.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all. Battle scenes are told plainly in the epic; the app keeps them brief.

ramayana-6-44-24.translation: Seeing Hanuman angry in battle like Death, taker of lives, the demons fled.
ramayana-6-44-24.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-25.translation: Seeing him coming, angry, frightening the demons, heroic Akampana grew angry and roared.
ramayana-6-44-25.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-26.translation: Akampana pierced mighty Hanuman with fourteen sharp arrows.
ramayana-6-44-26.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all. Battle scenes are told plainly in the epic; the app keeps them brief.

ramayana-6-44-27.translation: Pierced by many showers of arrows, heroic Hanuman looked like a mountain covered with growing trees.
ramayana-6-44-27.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-28.translation: Then tearing up another tree with unmatched speed, he quickly struck Akampana, lord of demons, on the head.
ramayana-6-44-28.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all. Battle scenes are told plainly in the epic; the app keeps them brief.

ramayana-6-44-29.translation: Struck by that tree by the angry great monkey lord, the demon fell and died.
ramayana-6-44-29.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all. Battle scenes are told plainly in the epic; the app keeps them brief.

ramayana-6-44-30.translation: Seeing Akampana, lord of demons, struck down on the ground, all the demons were shaken like trees in an earthquake.
ramayana-6-44-30.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-31.translation: Throwing away their weapons, all the defeated demons ran to Lanka in fear, chased by the monkeys.
ramayana-6-44-31.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-32.translation: Hair loose, panicked, pride broken, defeated, their limbs streaming with sweat, gasping, they fled.
ramayana-6-44-32.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-33.translation: Crushing each other they entered the city in fear, confused, looking back again and again.
ramayana-6-44-33.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-34.translation: When the demons had gone into Lanka, all the mighty monkeys gathered and honoured Hanuman.
ramayana-6-44-34.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-35.translation: Joyful, Hanuman, full of goodness, honoured all those monkeys in return, as each deserved, kindly.
ramayana-6-44-35.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all. Hanuman returns honour to his friends.

ramayana-6-44-36.translation: The victorious monkeys roared with all their might.
ramayana-6-44-36.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-37.translation: The great monkey, son of the Wind, gained a hero's glory by meeting and killing the demons and the great fearsome foe, as Vishnu did with Bali at the army's front.
ramayana-6-44-37.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-44-38.translation: Then the hosts of gods honoured the monkey, and so did Rama himself, mighty Lakshmana, the monkeys led by Sugriva, and mighty Vibhishana.
ramayana-6-44-38.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 44: Hanuman defeats Akampana and is honoured by all.

ramayana-6-45-1.translation: Hearing of Akampana's death, the lord of demons, angry and somewhat downcast, looked at his ministers.
ramayana-6-45-1.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-2.translation: After thinking a moment and talking with his ministers, he went round the city of Lanka to inspect all the posts.
ramayana-6-45-2.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-3.translation: He saw the city of Lanka guarded by hosts of demons, surrounded by many posts, garlanded with flags and banners.
ramayana-6-45-3.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-4.translation: Seeing the city blockaded, Ravana, lord of demons, angrily said at the right moment to Prahasta, skilled in war:
ramayana-6-45-4.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-5.translation: "For the city, besieged and suddenly pressed, I see no release other than battle, master of war."
ramayana-6-45-5.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-6.translation: "Only I, Kumbhakarna, you my commander, Indrajit or Nikumbha could carry such a burden."
ramayana-6-45-6.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-7.translation: "So quickly take a force from here and march out for victory to where all the forest-dwellers are."
ramayana-6-45-7.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-8.translation: "As soon as you march out, the fickle monkey army will surely flee on hearing the roar of the demon lords."
ramayana-6-45-8.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army. Ravana underestimates the monkeys again.

ramayana-6-45-9.translation: "Monkeys are fickle, undisciplined and restless; they will not bear your roar, as elephants cannot bear a lion's roar."
ramayana-6-45-9.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-10.translation: "When that army has fled, Rama with Saumitri, helpless and without support, will fall into Prahasta's power."
ramayana-6-45-10.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-11.translation: "Good fortune is uncertain in danger, not made certain here. Whether for or against, tell me what you think best for us."
ramayana-6-45-11.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-12.translation: Told this by Ravana, Prahasta the commander said to the demon king, as Ushanas speaks to the asura king:
ramayana-6-45-12.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-13.translation: "King, we have discussed this before with wise ministers, and there was disagreement among us after we looked at each other's views."
ramayana-6-45-13.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-14.translation: "I decided that the good lay in returning Sita; if she was not returned, we saw war, just as it has come."
ramayana-6-45-14.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army. Prahasta also once advised returning Sita.

ramayana-6-45-15.translation: "Always honoured by you with gifts, respect and many kind words in time, what would I not do to please you?"
ramayana-6-45-15.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-16.translation: "I do not guard my life, my sons, wife or wealth. See me offer my life in battle for you."
ramayana-6-45-16.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-17.translation: Having said this to his master Ravana, the commander said: "Bring me quickly a great army of demons."
ramayana-6-45-17.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-18.translation: "Today let the birds feed on those forest-dwellers struck on the battlefield by my thunderbolt-swift arrows."
ramayana-6-45-18.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army. A grim boast before battle.

ramayana-6-45-19.translation: Told this by Prahasta, the army chiefs hurried and made the army ready in that demon palace.
ramayana-6-45-19.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-20.translation: In a moment Lanka was crowded with those demon heroes with many sharp weapons, as with elephants.
ramayana-6-45-20.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-21.translation: As they fed the sacred fire and bowed to Brahmins, a fragrant wind blew carrying the scent of ghee.
ramayana-6-45-21.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-22.translation: The demons, ready for battle and thrilled, took and wore garlands of many shapes, charged with mantras.
ramayana-6-45-22.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-23.translation: With bows and armour, the demons leapt up swiftly and, seeing King Ravana, gathered round Prahasta.
ramayana-6-45-23.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-24.translation: Then, taking leave of the king and beating a fearsome drum, Prahasta mounted a divine chariot made ready.
ramayana-6-45-24.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-25.translation: It was yoked with very swift horses, well driven, roaring like a great cloud, shining like the moon and sun.
ramayana-6-45-25.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-26.translation: Hard to assail, with a serpent banner, good guard rails and fittings, with a golden net, it seemed to smile with splendour.
ramayana-6-45-26.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-27.translation: Mounting that chariot, with Ravana's command, he quickly went out of Lanka surrounded by a great army.
ramayana-6-45-27.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.

ramayana-6-45-28.translation: Then as the commander set out, the boom of kettledrums like thunder and the sound of conches were heard.
ramayana-6-45-28.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 45: Ravana sends his commander Prahasta, who marches out with a great army.
